video.title: Automate Your Lot Paperwork
video.script: You sold a car last week. Then came six hours of title transfers, financing docs, and state-specific paperwork. Most dealers don't talk about this part, but it's the tax on selling. Just 79 a month and the paperwork is done. Check the link to see how it works.
